# WordCamp Central

> WordCamp Central is the global hub for discovering, organizing, and connecting with WordPress community conferences and events worldwide.

WordCamp Central serves as the central directory and information portal for WordCamp conferences held globally. It connects the WordPress community through local and regional events, providing a platform for networking, learning, and collaboration around open-web technologies.

## Key Topics

- WordPress

## Main Hub

- [WordCamp Central – WordCamp is a conference that focuses on everything WordPress](https://central.wordcamp.org): Central hub for WordCamp conferences, WordPress community events and global event directory
